meta.title: Marketing Plan | Little Frenchie, Pererenan Bali | 741.Studio
meta.desc: A visibility and growth marketing plan for Little Frenchie in Pererenan, Bali, by 741.Studio.

hero.sub: The review showed where you stand on Google. This is what we do about it: the Google-Maps fix first, then organic video and paid ads, planned in full, each mapped to a real number from your own market.

cards.title: Phase 1: close the Google-Maps gap
cards.badge: visible at only 5 of 49 points today

cards.title: Organic: 3 video ideas, ready to shoot
Get named where guests already look
cards.sub: Reddit threads, a Pererenan travel guide

rounds.lead: 4.8 stars from 1,421 reviews is more proof than two of the three restaurants ranking ahead of you. The gap is not your food or your reputation, it is what Google knows about you.

items.title: Visible at 5 of 49 points
items.text: Average rank 15 for "restaurant pererenan", a search with 320 searches a month right in your own neighborhood.

items.title: The 3 restaurants ahead of you share one thing
items.text: They all carry the broad category "Restaurant" or "Brunch restaurant". You carry only "French restaurant". That is the whole gap, not reviews, not food quality.

items.title: Add categories: Brunch restaurant, Bistro, Cafe
items.text: Next to your existing French restaurant category, so the listing matches more of what people actually search.

items.title: Rewrite page titles and headings
items.text: Your two main headings today read "Instagram Little Frenchie" and "Facebook Little Frenchie". Google learns nothing about food or place from them.

rounds.good: The hard part is already done: 1,421 reviews and a 4.8 rating. What is missing is the categories and the text that tell Google what you serve and where.

rounds.h2: 3 video ideas, mapped to real searches
rounds.lead: Each idea targets a specific gap in what people already search for around Canggu and Pererenan. Starts once Phase 1 lands, so it does not compete for your attention during the fix, at 3-5 videos a week.

items.title: Single-Scene Hook: the steak frites
items.text: One plate, one take, no cuts. Targets "French restaurant Bali" (90/mo), your clearest point of difference. Needs no speaker.

items.title: Fast-Cut Story: the eggs benedict
items.text: Visuals only, the yolk running over the plate. Targets "brunch Canggu" (590/mo) and "best brunch Canggu" (210/mo). Needs no speaker.

items.title: Talk-to-Camera: "what should I order first?"
items.text: Targets "dinner Canggu" (1,000/mo), your highest-volume term. Needs a confirmed speaker, open question below.

items.title: Who is on camera?
items.text: You are the candidate, not yet confirmed. We ask you directly rather than assume. Ideas 1 and 2 can start either way.

rounds.good: Once a video proves itself, we do not brief new paid creative from zero. We take the clip that worked, add a call-to-action, and run it as the ad.

rounds.h2: Google Ads first, planned now, launches after Phase 1
rounds.lead: 2,400 people a month already search "best restaurant canggu". That is intent already looking for you, the kind of demand Google Ads sits directly on top of, faster than the listing work alone will fully capture it.

items.title: Google Ads, not Meta, first
items.text: Captures existing search intent now. Meta/Instagram becomes the second platform, built on the organic video once it exists.

items.title: A radius around Canggu and Pererenan
items.text: On your highest-volume terms: "best restaurant canggu" (2,400/mo), "dinner canggu" (1,000/mo), "brunch canggu" (590/mo).

items.title: Sourced from the organic videos
items.text: Not briefed separately. One production pipeline, not two.

items.title: Spend starts after Phase 1
items.text: Platform, targeting and creative source are specified now, so this is ready to execute the moment Phase 1 is done, not a vague future idea.

rounds.good: A real budget figure is not set here. The growth page's own calculator carries placeholder starting numbers for you to adjust in conversation, not a recommended spend.

rounds.h2: Get named in the conversations that already exist
rounds.lead: Real Reddit threads and a Pererenan travel guide already discuss exactly what you serve, without naming you. This starts once Phase 1 gives people somewhere solid to land.

items.title: "Best brunch in Canggu?"
items.text: A Reddit thread on r/bali with a list of replies. Little Frenchie is not named in the replies we could read.

items.title: "The best brunch and coffee spots in Pererenan"
items.text: A travel guide from November 2025 that calls Pererenan calmer than Canggu. It does not name Little Frenchie.

items.title: French fine-dining in Bali
items.text: A Reddit thread asking which French restaurants in Bali impressed people. Little Frenchie is not named in the snippet we read.

roadmap.what: Listing categories, page titles, headings, Google description.
roadmap.why: Captures existing demand fastest, lowest effort

roadmap.what: 3 formats, 3-5 videos a week, mapped to real search gaps.
roadmap.why: Builds discovery and legitimacy, feeds paid creative

roadmap.what: Targets Canggu/Pererenan searches, creative from the organic videos.
roadmap.why: Captures intent once the listing itself is fixed

roadmap.what: Reach out where Reddit threads and the travel guide already discuss her category.

final.p: 30 minutes, free: I walk you through this plan, in your market, with your real numbers. No strings attached.
